notes.note: Reviewed the dedicated five-case start-publication fixture after consolidating the regressions from the broad service suite. It asserts the durable event and recorded owner at accepted return, immediate authorized send, no owner/send authority after an indeterminate timeout, genuine deferred-start fallback under real peer contention, and failed-stop handle visibility without a durable start. Await removal fails the two intended assertions and restoration passes all five. The Session API creation/deferred-start limits remain accurate; provider-turn delivery is not inferred.
